card.openApp.description: Accessible name and tooltip of an app's icon wherever the icon is a link: activating it opens that app. "Open" is a verb. {{app}} is the app's name.

pill.missingSecrets.description: Small red chip on an app's card or row: the app cannot run yet because required secret values (API keys and the like) have not been set.

pill.missingSecretsTip_one.text: {{count}} required secret unset. Set values in the app's Secrets panel
pill.missingSecretsTip_one.description: Tooltip of the "Missing secrets" chip on an app. {{count}} is how many required secret values are not set yet. "Secrets" is the name of a panel in the app's settings.

pill.missingSecretsTip_other.text: {{count}} required secrets unset. Set values in the app's Secrets panel
pill.missingSecretsTip_other.description: Tooltip of the "Missing secrets" chip on an app. {{count}} is how many required secret values are not set yet. "Secrets" is the name of a panel in the app's settings.

pill.toVote_one.description: Small amber chip on an app's card or row: {{count}} proposed changes to this app are waiting for the viewer's community to vote on them.

pill.toVote_other.description: Small amber chip on an app's card or row: {{count}} proposed changes to this app are waiting for the viewer's community to vote on them.

pill.toVoteTip_one.description: Tooltip of the "to vote" chip on an app. {{count}} is the number of proposed changes (noun) to the app that are waiting for votes.

pill.toVoteTip_other.description: Tooltip of the "to vote" chip on an app. {{count}} is the number of proposed changes (noun) to the app that are waiting for votes.

pill.inDev_one.description: Small blue chip on an app's card or row: {{count}} build sessions, in which someone is developing a change to the app, are in progress. "dev" is short for development.

pill.inDev_other.description: Small blue chip on an app's card or row: {{count}} build sessions, in which someone is developing a change to the app, are in progress. "dev" is short for development.

pill.inDevTip_one.description: Tooltip of the "in dev" chip on an app. {{count}} is how many sessions of building (developing) a change to the app are under way. "Build" describes the session; it is not a command.

pill.inDevTip_other.description: Tooltip of the "in dev" chip on an app. {{count}} is how many sessions of building (developing) a change to the app are under way. "Build" describes the session; it is not a command.

pill.issues_one.description: Small grey chip on an app's card or row: {{count}} open issues (reported problems or requests) for the app.

pill.issues_other.description: Small grey chip on an app's card or row: {{count}} open issues (reported problems or requests) for the app.

pill.issuesTip_one.description: Tooltip of the issues chip on an app. {{count}} is how many issues are open, meaning not yet resolved. "Open" is an adjective.

pill.issuesTip_other.description: Tooltip of the issues chip on an app. {{count}} is how many issues are open, meaning not yet resolved. "Open" is an adjective.

pill.private.description: Chip with a lock icon on an app's card or row: only the app's members can open and use it.

pill.privateTip.text: Only members can open and use this app
pill.privateTip.description: Tooltip of the "Private" chip on an app. "Open" is a verb.

pill.inviteOnly.description: Chip with an envelope icon on an app's card or row: anyone can use the app, but only invited collaborators can build (develop changes to) it. "Build" is a noun here.

pill.inviteOnlyTip.text: Anyone can use this app; only invited collaborators can build it
pill.inviteOnlyTip.description: Tooltip of the "Invite-only build" chip on an app. "Build" is a verb: develop changes to the app.

browse.headerTitle.description: Title in the header bar of the Discover screen while it shows the list of every app.

search.placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the search field at the top of the Discover screen, which filters the list of every app.

search.label.description: Accessible name of the search field at the top of the Discover screen.

search.clear.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the × button inside Discover's search field: empties the field.

filter.groupLabel.description: Accessible name of the row of filter chips (All, Featured, Joined, New) under Discover's search field.

filter.all.description: Filter chip on the Discover screen: show every app.

filter.featured.description: Filter chip on the Discover screen: show only the apps Homeroom's staff picked to feature.

filter.joined.description: Filter chip on the Discover screen: show only the apps whose community the viewer has joined.

filter.new.description: Filter chip on the Discover screen: show only recently created apps.

sort.label.description: Label in front of the sort menu on the Discover screen. A noun: the order of the list.

sort.selectLabel.description: Accessible name of the sort menu on the Discover screen. "Sort" is a verb here.

sort.recommended.description: Option in Discover's sort menu: Homeroom's own order, reviewed working apps first.

sort.users.description: Option in Discover's sort menu: apps with the most active users first.

sort.active.description: Option in Discover's sort menu: apps with the most changes gone live in the last 30 days first.

sort.merged.description: Option in Discover's sort menu: apps with the most changes ever gone live first. "Changes" is a noun; "live" means released to users.

sort.newest.description: Option in Discover's sort menu: most recently created apps first.

loadError.directoryTitle.description: Title of the error card shown in place of Discover's list when the list of apps could not be fetched.

loadError.detail.text: Something went wrong reaching the app directory. Check your connection and try again.
loadError.detail.description: Second line of the error card shown when the list of apps could not be fetched, on Discover and on Home. A "Try again" button follows it.

empty.search.featured.description: Shown in place of Discover's list when the Featured filter is on and the search finds nothing. {{query}} is what the person typed; keep the quotation marks around it in your language's style.

empty.search.joined.description: Shown in place of Discover's list when the Joined filter is on and the search finds nothing. {{query}} is what the person typed.

empty.search.new.description: Shown in place of Discover's list when the New filter is on and the search finds nothing. {{query}} is what the person typed.

empty.search.all.description: Shown in place of Discover's list when the search finds nothing and no filter narrows it. {{query}} is what the person typed.

empty.featured.description: Shown in place of Discover's list when the Featured filter is on and no app is featured.

empty.joined.text: You haven’t joined anything yet. Join apps from All.
empty.joined.description: Shown in place of Discover's list when the Joined filter is on and the viewer has joined no app. "All" is the name of the first filter chip; use the same word as that chip.

empty.all.description: Shown in place of Discover's list when there are no apps at all (or none are new).

list.heading.reviewedWorking.description: Heading over the first group of rows in Discover's Recommended order: apps a reviewer has checked and found working.

list.heading.notYetReviewed.description: Heading over the second group of rows in Discover's Recommended order: apps nobody has reviewed yet.

list.label.notYetReviewed.description: Small label on one app's row in Discover: this app's current version has not been reviewed. Shown where no group heading already says it.

list.more.note.text: Demos and apps needing fixes, setup, or an icon are still available below and in search.
list.more.note.description: Note at the end of Discover's list, above the "Show more" button that reveals the apps kept out of the main list.

list.more.showLess.description: Button at the end of Discover's list: hides again the extra apps that "Show more" revealed.

list.more.showMore_one.description: Button at the end of Discover's list: reveals the apps kept out of the main list (demos, apps needing fixes). {{count}} is how many it reveals.

list.more.showMore_other.description: Button at the end of Discover's list: reveals the apps kept out of the main list (demos, apps needing fixes). {{count}} is how many it reveals.

list.join.action.description: Button on an app's row in Discover: join that app's community, which also puts the app on the viewer's Home. A verb.

list.join.joined.description: State shown, with a check mark, on the same button of a Discover row once the viewer is a member of the app's community. Pressing it asks whether to leave.

list.join.named.description: Accessible name of the Join button on an app's row in Discover. {{app}} is the app's name.

row.join.tip.description: Tooltip of the Join button on an app's row in Discover. {{app}} is the app's name.

row.join.joinedTip.description: Tooltip of the button on a Discover row when the viewer is already a member. {{app}} is the app's name. "Leave" means stop being a member of the app's community.

row.meta.users_one.description: First fact on the small grey line under an app's name in Discover. {{count}} is how many people actively use the app.

row.meta.users_other.description: First fact on the small grey line under an app's name in Discover. {{count}} is how many people actively use the app.

row.meta.liveRecently_one.description: Fact on the grey line under an app's name in Discover, under the Most active order: {{count}} changes to the app went live in the last 30 days. "30d" is short for 30 days.

row.meta.liveRecently_other.description: Fact on the grey line under an app's name in Discover, under the Most active order: {{count}} changes to the app went live in the last 30 days. "30d" is short for 30 days.

row.meta.changesLive_one.description: Fact on the grey line under an app's name in Discover, under the Most changes live order: {{count}} changes to the app have ever gone live. "Change" is a noun.

row.meta.changesLive_other.description: Fact on the grey line under an app's name in Discover, under the Most changes live order: {{count}} changes to the app have ever gone live. "Change" is a noun.

row.meta.created.description: Fact on the grey line under an app's name in Discover, under the Newest order. {{when}} is a short relative time such as "3d ago" or "just now".

row.meta.updated.description: Fact on the grey line under an app's name in Discover: when the app's latest version went live. {{when}} is a short relative time such as "3d ago" or "just now".

row.meta.pair.description: Joins two short facts on one line of an app's row or a contributor's row ("12 users · Updated 3d ago"). {{first}} is everything said so far and {{second}} the next fact. Keep a separator your language uses for such a run of facts.

row.status.creating.description: Last fact on the grey line under an app's name in Discover, and the tooltip of its status dot: the app is being set up and is not running yet.

row.status.awaitingSecrets.description: Last fact on the grey line under an app's name in Discover: the app is waiting for its required secret values (API keys and the like) to be set.

row.status.error.description: Last fact on the grey line under an app's name in Discover: the app failed to build or start.

time.justNow.description: A relative time inside "Updated …" or "Created …" on Discover: less than a minute ago. Lower case because it follows another word.

time.minutesAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" or "Created …" on Discover. {{count}} is a number of minutes; "m" abbreviates minutes.

time.minutesAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" or "Created …" on Discover. {{count}} is a number of minutes; "m" abbreviates minutes.

time.hoursAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" or "Created …" on Discover. {{count}} is a number of hours; "h" abbreviates hours.

time.hoursAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" or "Created …" on Discover. {{count}} is a number of hours; "h" abbreviates hours.

time.daysAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" or "Created …" on Discover. {{count}} is a number of days; "d" abbreviates days.

time.daysAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" or "Created …" on Discover. {{count}} is a number of days; "d" abbreviates days.

time.monthsAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" or "Created …" on Discover. {{count}} is a number of months; "mo" abbreviates months.

time.monthsAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" or "Created …" on Discover. {{count}} is a number of months; "mo" abbreviates months.

time.yearsAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" or "Created …" on Discover. {{count}} is a number of years; "y" abbreviates years.

time.yearsAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" or "Created …" on Discover. {{count}} is a number of years; "y" abbreviates years.

detail.unavailable.description: Shown on an app's page in Discover when the app does not exist or the viewer may not see it.

detail.backToAll.description: Link under "That app isn’t available.": returns to Discover's list. Keep the leading arrow.

detail.blocked.note.text: You blocked this app. Unblock it to open it again.
detail.blocked.note.description: Shown on an app's page in Discover when the viewer has blocked that app. "Blocked" means the viewer chose not to see it; "open" is a verb.

detail.blocked.settingsLink.description: Link under "You blocked this app.": goes to the list of blocked apps in Settings. "Open" is a verb.

detail.remixedFrom.line.description: Line under an app's version on its page in Discover: this app was made as a copy (a remix) of another app. {{app}} is the original app's name. Keep the leading ⑂ symbol.

detail.remixedFrom.openOriginal.description: Tooltip of the "Remixed from" line on an app's page when the original app can be opened. {{app}} is the original app's name. "Open" is a verb.

detail.remixedFrom.originalGone.text: The original app no longer exists
detail.remixedFrom.originalGone.description: Tooltip of the "Remixed from" line on an app's page when the app it was copied from has been deleted.

detail.updated.description: Line under an app's name on its page in Discover: when its latest version went live. {{when}} is a short relative time such as "3d ago" or "just now".

detail.open.action.description: Main button on an app's page in Discover: opens the app so it can be used. A verb.

detail.open.creating.description: Label of the disabled main button on an app's page in Discover while the app is being set up and cannot be opened yet.

detail.open.notRunning.description: Label of the disabled main button on an app's page in Discover when the app failed to start.

detail.open.unavailable.description: Label of the disabled main button on an app's page in Discover when the app cannot be opened and its state is unknown.

detail.myApps.add.description: Second button on an app's page in Discover: puts a tile for the app on the viewer's Home screen. "My apps" is the name of that section of Home.

detail.myApps.remove.description: Second button on an app's page in Discover when the app already has a tile on the viewer's Home: takes the tile away. "My apps" is the name of that section of Home.

detail.share.label.description: First row of the actions list on an app's page in Discover: shares a link to the app. A verb.

detail.share.tip.text: Share a link to this app
detail.share.tip.description: Tooltip of the Share row on an app's page in Discover.

detail.share.copied.description: Brief notice after the Share row copied the app's link to the clipboard, on a device with no share sheet.

detail.share.copyFailed.description: Brief notice when the Share row on an app's page could not copy the app's link to the clipboard.

detail.contributors.heading.description: Heading of the card listing the people who contributed to an app, on the app's page in Discover, before their number is known.

detail.contributors.headingCount_one.description: Heading of the contributors card on an app's page in Discover, with the number of contributors in lighter text. {{count}} is that number; the numbered tag wraps the lighter part, separator included.

detail.contributors.headingCount_other.description: Heading of the contributors card on an app's page in Discover, with the number of contributors in lighter text. {{count}} is that number; the numbered tag wraps the lighter part, separator included.

detail.contributors.tip.text: The app’s creator, its members, and everyone with a change that went live in it
detail.contributors.tip.description: Tooltip of the "Contributors" heading on an app's page: who the list counts.

detail.contributors.loading.description: Shown inside the contributors card on an app's page while the list is being fetched.

detail.contributors.loadFailed.description: Shown inside the contributors card on an app's page when the list could not be fetched.

detail.contributors.none.description: Shown inside the contributors card on an app's page when nobody has contributed to the app.

detail.contributors.showFewer.description: Button at the foot of the contributors card on an app's page: folds the list back to its first five people.

detail.contributors.showAll_one.description: Button at the foot of the contributors card on an app's page: unfolds the whole list. {{count}} is the total number of contributors.

detail.contributors.showAll_other.description: Button at the foot of the contributors card on an app's page: unfolds the whole list. {{count}} is the total number of contributors.

detail.contributor.viewChanges.description: Tooltip of a person's row in the contributors card on an app's page: opens that person's page. {{username}} is their username; keep the @ in front of it. "Changes" is a noun.

detail.contributor.viewChangesUnnamed.description: Tooltip of a person's row in the contributors card on an app's page: opens that person's page. Used for a contributor whose username is not known; "@unknown" is written as the tooltip has always shown it.

detail.contributor.unknownHandle.description: Shown where a username would be, on a row in the contributors card on an app's page, for a contributor whose username is not known. Stands alone; keep it short.

detail.contributor.creator.description: Small grey word under a contributor's username on an app's page: this person created the app.

detail.contributor.member.description: Small grey word under a contributor's username on an app's page: this person is a member of the app's community.

detail.contributor.votes_one.description: Small grey fact under a contributor's username on an app's page: how many votes this person has cast on the app's proposed changes.

detail.contributor.votes_other.description: Small grey fact under a contributor's username on an app's page: how many votes this person has cast on the app's proposed changes.

detail.contributor.live_one.description: Pill at the end of a contributor's row on an app's page: {{count}} of this person's changes to the app have gone live (been released).

detail.contributor.live_other.description: Pill at the end of a contributor's row on an app's page: {{count}} of this person's changes to the app have gone live (been released).

detail.contributor.liveTip.text: Their changes that went live in this app
detail.contributor.liveTip.description: Tooltip of the "live" pill on a contributor's row: what the number counts. "Changes" is a noun.

illustration.title.description: Title, and accessible name, of the dialog where an app's owner sets the picture shown on the app's card in Home's Discover rail.

illustration.previewCaption.description: Caption over the sample card in the featured illustration editor: this is how the card will look on Discover. "Preview" is a noun.

illustration.theme.group.description: Accessible name of the Light / Dark pair of buttons in the featured illustration editor, which switch the sample card between the two colour themes.

illustration.theme.light.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: show the sample card in the light colour theme.

illustration.theme.dark.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: show the sample card in the dark colour theme.

illustration.framingLabel.text: Illustration framing: drag to move, scroll or pinch to zoom, arrow keys to nudge
illustration.framingLabel.description: Accessible name of the sample card in the featured illustration editor, where the picture is positioned and zoomed.

illustration.framingHelp.text: Drag the card to move the image. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Zoom <0>{{percent}}%</0>.
illustration.framingHelp.description: Help line under the upload buttons in the featured illustration editor, ending with the current zoom level. {{percent}} is a whole number such as 120; the numbered tag wraps the live readout.

illustration.upload.fileLabel.description: Accessible name of the hidden file chooser in the featured illustration editor.

illustration.upload.light.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: choose the picture used in the light colour theme, when none is set yet.

illustration.upload.replaceLight.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: choose a different picture for the light colour theme.

illustration.upload.dark.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: choose a separate picture for the dark colour theme.

illustration.upload.replaceDark.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: choose a different picture for the dark colour theme.

illustration.upload.useLightInBoth.text: Use light image in both themes
illustration.upload.useLightInBoth.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: drop the separate dark-theme picture so the light one is used everywhere.

illustration.upload.formats.text: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 20 MB.
illustration.upload.formats.description: Small note under the upload button in the featured illustration editor: the accepted file types and size. Keep the format names.

illustration.upload.sameDimensions.text: Use images with the same dimensions. Framing and colour are shared across both themes.
illustration.upload.sameDimensions.description: Small note in the featured illustration editor about the light and dark pictures.

illustration.cardColour.description: Label, and accessible name, of the row of colour swatches in the featured illustration editor: the background colour of the app's card.

illustration.resetPosition.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: puts the picture back to its default position and zoom.

illustration.useAppIcon.description: Button in the featured illustration editor: removes the illustration so the card shows the app's icon instead.

illustration.loadingPreview.description: Shown in the featured illustration editor while the current illustration is being fetched.

illustration.loadFailed.text: Could not load the illustration. Reopen the editor to try again.
illustration.loadFailed.description: Error in the featured illustration editor when the current illustration could not be fetched and the server gave no message of its own.

illustration.saveFailed.description: Error in the featured illustration editor when proposing the change failed and the server gave no message of its own.

illustration.sent.text: Sent to the group for approval. The illustration changes when the vote passes. <0>Open the proposal</0>
illustration.sent.description: Shown in the featured illustration editor after the change was submitted for the community's vote. The numbered tag is a link to the proposal (noun: the change put to a vote); "Open" is a verb.

illustration.pending.text: A change to this illustration is already waiting for the group's vote. Another can be proposed once it settles. <0>Open the proposal</0>
illustration.pending.description: Shown in the featured illustration editor when an earlier change to the illustration is still being voted on. The numbered tag is a link to that proposal (noun); "Open" is a verb.

illustration.proposeNote.text: Proposing opens a governance card on the board. The change applies when the group votes it in.
illustration.proposeNote.description: Small note above the buttons of the featured illustration editor: what pressing "Propose change" does. The board is the project's list of proposals.

illustration.propose.description: Main button of the featured illustration editor: submits the new illustration for the community's vote. "Change" is a noun.

illustration.pleaseWait.description: Label of the main button of the featured illustration editor while an upload or save is in progress.
